patterns: OpenAI Pro reasoning mode is required
failure_patterns.explanation: The runtime configuration or bundled source validation failed.
next_actions: Run docker compose exec -T translume-api python scripts/validate_prime_directives.py --force --output-dir /data/audit/runtime_diagnostics.
Restore the supplied Compose configuration and bundled source archives if their hashes or provider settings were modified.

patterns: cannot connect to the docker daemon
permission denied while trying to connect to the Docker daemon
failure_patterns.explanation: Docker Engine or Docker Compose could not be used by the current account.
next_actions: Install and start Docker Desktop, or Docker Engine with the Compose plugin on Linux.
Confirm docker compose version and docker info succeed with the same user account.

failure_patterns.explanation: OpenAI rejected the credentials, model access, or account quota.
next_actions: Check the real OPENAI_API_KEY in .env and the OpenAI project's billing and Astra model access.
Recreate the affected services after changing .env using docker compose up -d.
Inspect docker compose logs --tail=300 translume-api docling-service medea-service precision-oncology-pipeline dynamic-pathway-analyzer.

failure_patterns.explanation: A remote inference request failed, was refused, or did not produce a complete valid result.
next_actions: Inspect the failing stage's actual response ID, usage receipt, and completion reason in its audit artifacts.
Resolve the reported provider or input failure before rerunning verification; an incomplete output is not a successful report.

failure_patterns.explanation: A bundled source archive or the required real reference dataset could not be verified or downloaded.
next_actions: Inspect docker compose logs --tail=300 data-init.
Verify network access to Hugging Face and Harvard Dataverse; resolve any actual access restriction with the data provider.
Run docker compose run --rm data-init after correcting the reported failure, then docker compose up -d.
Keep the exact supplied source archives; do not replace required data with sample files.

failure_patterns.explanation: The internal OpenSearch service or required index is unavailable.
next_actions: Inspect docker compose logs --tail=300 opensearch data-init.
Run docker compose run --rm data-init after OpenSearch is healthy.

failure_patterns.explanation: The internal Postgres service or required schema is unavailable.
next_actions: Inspect docker compose logs --tail=300 postgres data-init.
Run docker compose run --rm data-init after Postgres is healthy.

patterns: integration report must be a PDF
failure_patterns.explanation: The real integration PDF is missing, unreadable, or failed remote document extraction.
next_actions: Place the actual report PDF at data/input/report.pdf and set TRANSLUME_E2E_DIAGNOSIS to its actual diagnosis in .env.
Inspect docker compose logs --tail=300 docling-service translume-api.

patterns: Packet has no actual OpenAI generation receipts
failure_patterns.explanation: The real review packet did not satisfy its completeness or provenance contract.
next_actions: Inspect the generated artifacts and the first failing validation message.
Correct the reported stage and rerun docker compose --profile verification run --rm verify.

patterns: UI returned an empty response body
failure_patterns.explanation: The Gradio application did not return a successful real HTTP response.
next_actions: Inspect docker compose logs --tail=300 translume-ui translume-api.
Confirm the API container is healthy and Docker has sufficient allocated RAM.
